Reordered options and word-boundary contamination corrected explicitly in scripts/nda-2025-ii-source-review.mjs. No original required diagram occurs in these 150 items.
signoff.secondPassMethod: Reopened all original question-page renders in reverse page order 49 down to 2, and cover 1, after writing explicit corrections. Compared complete statements and every A–D option, negatives, false original propositions, chemical equations, tables, shared directions and underlined targets. Preserved Q108’s original anomalous product and did not rewrite faithful keyed disagreements. Original document SHA-256 rechecked against the supplied local PDF.
signoff.classificationMethod: Fresh complete-question reread followed by review of all 150 concept decisions and registry boundaries. Corrected feldspar to Minerals, sedimentary formation to Sedimentary Rocks, tropical-storm conditions to Tropical Cyclones, WMO to specialised agencies, and medieval travellers to a bounded medieval source chapter. Language ordering questions remain English, not History/Economy/Polity. Pure school science has explicit NDA/CDS preparation applicability, not automatic CSE GS transfer. Crypto assets have reviewed Economy and technology homes. Static/Event-based decisions follow the question’s task and supported dates, not paper-position or exam year.
signoff.keyReview: Series A, page 1 of the four-page directly recovered UPSC PDF. All 150 cells visually compared with the column-first and row-first transcriptions.
